name: Changelog Master Build Kit 🔔
description_md:
# What You Get
Complete Build Specification: The full technical spec to build Changelog Master from scratch - architecture diagram, tech stack, database schema, API endpoints, React components, services, hooks, and design system with exact hex codes. Everything you need to one-shot this app.
Architecture Walkthrough: Plain-English guide explaining how every piece of the system works - from GitHub fetch to Gemini analysis to TTS audio to email notifications. Includes ASCII diagrams, workflow breakdowns, and data flow visualizations.
Prompt Playbook: The actual prompts used to build this app, organized by phase. 
Each prompt includes the original version and a refined version showing what works better - plus 8 prompting principles and reusable templates for new features, design changes, and bug fixes.
This is the exact documentation package I used to build Changelog Master - the AI-powered changelog tracker that keeps me up-to-date on every Claude Code update.
Join Early AI-dopters for video walkthroughs, exclusive content, and live coaching sessions: 
https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
